description: The chart titled “SimpleQA performance over the course of post-training” illustrates how response outcomes are distributed across four post-training stages using stacked bars. The horizontal axis contains the stage categories in left-to-right order “Base,” “SFT,” “DPO Stage 1,” and “Final,” with an additional small “6.8%” text shown beneath the leftmost position; the vertical axis is labeled “Percentage (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 100 with tick marks at 20-point intervals. Each stage is represented by a vertical stacked bar with three color-coded segments indicated by the legend: green for “Correct,” dark navy for “Not Attempted,” and a very light blue for the remaining outcome segment (unlabeled in the legend text but shown as the third stack color). In the “Base” bar, the green “Correct” segment is labeled 3.2%, the dark navy “Not Attempted” segment is a small band above it (approximately 6.8% based on the nearby text), and the light segment occupies most of the bar and is labeled 90.0%. In “SFT,” the green segment is labeled 3.7%, the dark navy segment is labeled 57.5%, and the light segment at the top is labeled 38.7%. In “DPO Stage 1,” the green segment is labeled 2.9%, the dark navy segment is labeled 79.8%, and the light segment is labeled 17.4%. In “Final,” the green segment is labeled 3.0%, the dark navy segment is labeled 81.1%, and the light segment is labeled 15.8%. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by magnitude beyond the fixed stage order, and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or callout annotations beyond the percentage labels inside segments.
